sources.title: Making Belady-Inspired Replacement Policies More Effective Using Expected Hit Count
sources.snippet: Memory-intensive workloads operate on massive amounts of data that cannot be captured by last-level caches (LLCs) of modern processors. Consequently, processors encounter frequent off-chip misses, and hence, lose a significant performance potential. One way to reduce the number of off-chip misses is through using a well-behaved replacement policy in the LLC.
